heldReason.note: The dictionary writes 靑, whose lower box is closed by a single vertical, where MM — its only candidate — writes 青 with the two bars of 月 inside. That is a different stroke, not a different direction or order, so the glyph fails closed and stays out of the runtime and out of later queues. Same component and same treatment as 睛, 猜 and 鯖 in the earlier grades.

corpusOverrides.note: All three came out clean. 腆 → Hans and 畋 → MM each dropped two flagged strokes (max 98° and 100°) to none over 17° and 18°, because Ja reorders the inner bars of 典 and of 田. 灾 → Hans is the narrowest override so far: MM leaves the opening dot of 火 at 63°, just over the threshold, and the simplified file draws the same dot at 59°, inside the range kept as licensed geometry everywhere else.

directionProbe.threshold: angle over 60° between dictionary and candidate start-to-end vectors
directionProbe.note: 灾, 腆 and 畋 disappeared when the corpus changed. 茲, 糴, 瀍 and 慥 were resolved by reordering and 耔, 趯, 裎, 鋥 and the remaining tick of 糴 by an authored path. 靚 7 turned out to be the 靑 form difference and was held. The endpoint assignment check added 牂 and 纔, whose strokes run in the same direction and differ only in order. Recomputed against the published order and paths, no stroke is over 60°.

subThresholdSlants.method: direction-probe rows recomputed against the published order and paths: 9 rows between 45° and 60°, none corrected
subThresholdSlants.note: Short opening dots and marks the dictionary draws vertically or steeper than the licensed corpora (漳 4 at 51°, 灾 1 at 56° and 4 at 59°, 纔 17 at 55°, 旃 1 at 59°, 瀍 4 at 55°, 鱣 12 at 53°, 裎 1 at 58°, 躋 8 at 49°). Kept as licensed geometry, as in the earlier batches.

sourceTransform.note: Two dictionary groups carry a horizontal offset, translate(12, -830), as in each batch since 厲 in batch 4. serve.py, source-checks.mjs and direction-probe.mjs accept translate(x, -y), and the published paths come from the licensed corpus, so the offset only affects what the review sheet draws.
